content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not weigh a live pressed link chain against chain; it concludes the challenged curse limb was already dropped, so K-C's collision rule is not triggered.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"\"pressed against a link\": one reading requires a live link to trigger chain-vs-chain weighing; the other would require weighing even a challenge to a dropped limb.","why":"Because the judge relies on the recorded dropping of the target limb rather than the retired stating-verse test or a verse-by-verse comparison, it does not breach K-C."}
